comment: Figure 3.3-3.5 uses ArchiMate colours to layer the sub-goal and outcome, capabilities and services, and metadata components for the "Establish Trusted Personal Health Records" sub-goal, but the colour coding does not visually distinguish DPI-F, DPI-H, and functional application elements from one another elsewhere in the document these three are referred to by different names/labels, so the same or similar colours mapping to inconsistently-named categories makes the layering hard to interpret correctly.

public.text: Figure 3.3-3.5 uses ArchiMate colours to layer the sub-goal and outcome, capabilities and services, and metadata components for the "Establish Trusted Personal Health Records" sub-goal, but the colour coding does not visually distinguish DPI-F, DPI-H, and functional application elements from one another elsewhere in the document these three are referred to by different names/labels, so the same or similar colours mapping to inconsistently-named categories makes the layering hard to interpret correctly.
public.suggestedRevision: Assign DPI-F, DPI-H, and functional applications distinct, consistently-applied colours in Figure, with a legend that cross-references the terminology used for each category elsewhere in the document, so the colour-to-term mapping is unambiguous throughout.
